mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_reconciliation_anomaly (anomaly_type,coupon_id,status,occurrence_count,clean_scan_count,sample_user_id, sample_order_number,details_hash,version,first_seen_at,last_seen_at) VALUES (#{anomalyType},#{couponId},'OPEN',1,0,#{sampleUserId},#{sampleOrderNumber},#{detailsHash}, 0,NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occurrence_count=occurrence_count+1, clean_scan_count=0, sample_user_id=VALUES(sample_user_id), sample_order_number=VALUES(sample_order_number), details_hash=VALUES(details_hash), status='OPEN',resolved_at=NULL,version=version+1,last_seen_at=NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_reconciliation_anomaly SET clean_scan_count=clean_scan_count+1, status=CASE WHEN clean_scan_count+1>=2 THEN 'RESOLVED' ELSE status END, resolved_at=CASE WHEN clean_scan_count+1>=2 THEN NOW(3) ELSE resolved_at END, version=version+1 WHERE coupon_id=#{couponId} AND status='OPEN' AND last_seen_at<#{cycleStartedAt} AND anomaly_type IN ('INVALID_RESERVATION_MEMBER','INVALID_REGISTRY_MEMBER', 'REGISTRY_LEDGER_MISMATCH','LEDGER_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH')
